thread:
marc: Quick follow-up from the partial-response postmortem — we need clear owners and a handoff plan for timeouts + partial responses on the chat/stream endpoint. Proposing owners: @kevin for reconnect/backoff logic, @lina for customer-facing tickets, @anya for observability and alerts. Timeline: triage + repro by EOD, patch PR in 48h, canary next week. Thoughts? 
kevin: I'm ok owning reconnect/backoff. I'll start with a small reproducer and a config change for backoff jitter. Can someone link the failing request logs? 
lina: I'll update affected customer threads (RD-9812, RD-9830). Need to know which deployments were hit (hosted vs dedicated). 
anya: I'll add dashboards for partial-response rates and handshake timeouts. Can we get example logs and the client IDs? 
marc: logs here: <https://storage.redwood.internal/incident/1865432100/logs> and stack traces in the incident doc. Note: one pattern is client disconnects after 9s with no partials; server shows stuck in kv-cache swap. 
kevin: hunch: kv-cache eviction + blocking GC path causing stall. Will instrument with timestamps around kv fetch/evict. 
ops-bot: Deploy RD-runtime v1.22.3 to canary cluster scheduled for 202.49.21.12 at 2026-03-10T21:00Z :rotating_light: 
anya: For dashboards I'll track metrics: partial_response_rate, handshake_timeout_count, avg_first_token_ms. Also add alert: >0.5% partial_response_rate for 5m. 
lina: Customer comms draft: "We're rolling a fix to improve connection handshakes and reduce partial responses. ETA canary next week, full rollout after verification." Ping me if changes. 
kevin: Plan for reconnect logic: introduce exponential backoff with capped jitter, add client-side ACK after first partial, server will send periodic keepalive pings every 5s to prevent stalling. 
marc: Nice. Owner assignments: kevin -> RD-10021, anya -> RD-10022 (observability), lina -> RD-10023 (customer comms). I'll add timeline to the postmortem follow-up doc. 
anya: Quick question — for the keepalive change, will it be a config flag? if yes, mark as toggleable for canary. 
kevin: Yes, config flag + default off for older clients. We'll document rollout steps: canary, 50%, 100% with metrics gate. 
marc: Can everyone drop short status updates in this thread daily until closure? I'll run a weekly sync if needed. 
lina: ack, will post customer statuses. :white_check_mark: 
kevin: started reproducer, pushing logs to RD bucket, will open RD-10021 today. 
anya: dashboards started, alert dev runbook draft at <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partial-resp>. 
marc: thanks all. tagging @incident-bot to add these action items to the postmortem. 
incident-bot: Action items recorded: RD-10021 (kevin), RD-10022 (anya), RD-10023 (lina). ETA fields set per thread. 
kevin: one more: need to audit client SDKs for aggressive reconnect behaviour. adding RD-10024. 
marc: good call. That one will be low priority but needed. next update tomorrow 10:00 PT.
